meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会让你在终端运行 bash nanoclaw.sh;该脚本自动完成 NanoClaw 的安装配置(依赖、镜像、OneCLI 保险库、凭据、服务、首个 agent 等),出错时提供 Claude 协助的恢复并从中断处继续。
howto.when: 当你说“setup”“install”等关键词,或要求安装/配置 NanoClaw、进行首次设置时触发。

say.note: Claude 会引导你运行 nanoclaw.sh

say.text: 重新执行 NanoClaw 设置

howto.what_en: Claude will tell you to run `bash nanoclaw.sh` in your terminal. The script handles NanoClaw setup (dependencies, container image, OneCLI vault, credential, service, first agent). On error, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes from where it stopped.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like "setup", "install", or "configure nanoclaw", or ask to install/configure NanoClaw or do first-time setup.

say_en.note: Claude will guide you to run nanoclaw.sh

say_en.text: I want to install and configure NanoClaw
Resume NanoClaw setup from the error
say_en.note: The script continues from where it stopped
